Search and AI visibility for tradespeople

Work every week to keep you showing on Google and named when somebody asks an assistant for a tradesperson. It is the Local plan: £89 a month, with a three month minimum and then rolling on thirty days notice. There are five places on it.

Ask about this

What the plan does

Four things, and they keep running after launch rather than stopping at it. Search work stopped being a job you finish some years ago.

  • A Google profile post every week
  • Every Google review replied to within a week
  • Review cards topped up when you run low
  • An AI visibility check every quarter, with one page properly refreshed

What nobody can promise you

A place in an assistant's answer. Anyone who promises you one is guessing, and the honest version of this work is making sure that when a machine goes looking, everything it finds about you agrees with everything else: the same name, the same number, the same trade on your site, your Google profile and every directory you appear in. What GEO is, and why it matters for trades sets out what an assistant is actually reading.

When you cannot wait a quarter

Google Ads. For when you need the phone ringing this week and cannot wait a quarter for the search work to take. You pay Google directly, from your own card on your own account, so the budget is yours and you can see every penny of it. We tell you what we charge to manage it, and what Google needs as a minimum budget for the ads to run properly, before you commit to anything. It is priced individually, so get in touch and we will tell you what it would cost.

What it sits on top of

None of this works without a site worth sending people to and a Google listing that is filled in. Both are in the plan already: Local contains Managed, which contains Online. If you only want the site, that is the websites for tradespeople page. Every figure is on the prices page.

Questions people ask first

How long before it works?

Search work takes months rather than weeks to show, so it is worth judging over a season. If you need the phone ringing this week, Google Ads is the faster route, and you pay Google directly for the ads either way.

Can you promise I will be named by ChatGPT?

No, and nobody can. What we can do is make sure the facts an assistant finds about you are consistent and easy to quote, which is what decides whether you are in the answer or not.

Is there a minimum term?

Three months on Local, then it is rolling on thirty days notice. Online and Managed are rolling from the start.

Do you take a cut of my ad budget?

No. You pay Google directly, from your own card on your own account, so the budget is yours and you can see every penny of it. What we charge to manage the ads is priced individually and covers our work, nothing else.

How quickly will you get back to me?

Send an enquiry on a weekday and you will hear back the same day.

Ready to get on with it?

Ring and describe what you do and what you want it to bring you. We’ll tell you which of these fits and what it would cost, in plain English.
